name: Gatekeeper says 'Just send us an email'
description: Tests Play 9 — agree + get a specific name so the email isn't lost in a shared inbox.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: This is Harmony Dental, Sarah speaking.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey Sarah, quick one. When the front desk is slammed, do calls go to voicemail or keep ringing?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Oh, you know what, just send us an email. We're really busy right now.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Play 9 — agree and get a specific name. Do not fire Play 26 (not interested re-engage) because she didn't say not interested, she said send email.
